title: Ariba enrollment — MSA amendments and PO header / ACK window
text:
Ariba enrollment — MSA amendments and PO header / ACK window

["From: jane.thompson@acmecorp.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: vendor-ops@procureplus.com
Date: Sat, 29 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ariba registration / MSA preliminary redlines

Hi Karthik —

Thanks for sending through the portal invite. We're working through your standard MSA and had a couple of asks before we complete vendor enrollment in Ariba: 

1) Our legal team highlighted three change requests to the MSA (section 6.2 liability cap, section 11 audit notice period, and indemnity carve-outs). I attached the vendor redline (Redline_MSA_v3). Can you confirm Redwood legal will review these or should we route via your procurement contact?

2) For Ariba onboarding, we need to confirm the PO header fields: our ERP needs PO_NUMBER, SCHEDULE_CODE, TAX_JURISDICTION and a 3-character vendor_code in the header for automation. Can you share the PO header mapping template so we can validate?

3) Finally, what's your expected ACK window for EDI/ACK after PO transmission? Our ops team enforces a 48-hour SLA; any deviation will require a manual exception.

Appreciate quick visibility — we have an internal procurement cutover scheduled for 06/07.

Best,
Jane Thompson\Senior Sourcing Manager\Acme Corp

[Attachment: Redline_MSA_v3_KI_comments.docx (DOCX)]", "From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: jane.thompson@acmecorp.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai, vendor-ops@procureplus.com
Date: Sat, 29 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Ariba registration / MSA preliminary redlines

Jane — thanks, received and looping in legal + ops. Quick plan below: 

- Marissa (legal) will triage the redline and confirm which requests are deal-breakers vs. negotiables. Expect an initial response by EOD Mon (05/31).
- Mateo (integration) will share our PO header mapping template and confirm whether we can populate the 3-char vendor_code during enrollment or via a subsequent vendor attribute update. He will also clarify the ACK behavior for Ariba -> Redwood (we translate to your ERP).
- Vendor Ops (ProcurePlus) is copied to confirm any portal-side constraints for vendor_code and field length.

Action items for you: can you attach a sample PO XML or a screenshot of your ERP's expected header? That will speed mapping validation.

Thanks — talk soon.

Karthik Iyer\Senior Sales Engineer\Redwood Inference
", "From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 16:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Ariba registration / MSA preliminary redlines

Karthik / Team — reviewed Jane's vendor redline. High-level notes: 

- Liability cap (Sec 6.2): we can accept a proportional cap tied to 12 months' fees, not unlimited. Draft counter in the attached doc (Redline_MSA_v3_KI_comments.docx) with rationale.
- Audit notice (Sec 11): propose 10 business days (instead of 30) and a scoping limit.
- Indemnity: request removing third-party punitive damages clause; we've proposed specific carve-outs for IP and data breaches.

We should avoid re-opening broad indemnity language — propose a short call with Acme legal if they push material changes. Mateo — see my inline comment about the order form language: can we add a vendor_attribute (vendor_code) that accepts 3 chars at onboarding? If ProcurePlus can't store it at registration time, we can accept a post-registration attribute write but must log the change for audit.

I'm fine with Karthik sharing the PO Header mapping template now; legal has redlines and we'll mark the items we need legal sign-off on for the counter.

Marissa Cole\Sr. Counsel, Commercial\Redwood Inference

[Attachment: Redline_MSA_v3_KI_comments.docx (DOCX)]", "From: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
To: jane.thompson@acmecorp.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, vendor-ops@procureplus.com
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 14:20:00 -07:00
Subject: PO Header mapping + ACK window — follow-up

Hi Jane — attaching our PO_Header_Mapping_Template.xlsx and a quick summary below: 

- Fields we emit from Redwood to Ariba/ERP: PO_NUMBER (string), LINE_NUMBER (int), ITEM_CODE (string), QUANTITY, UNIT_PRICE, SCHEDULE_CODE (opt), TAX_JURISDICTION (string), VENDOR_CODE (optional, 3 chars).
- VENDOR_CODE: ProcurePlus allows a custom attribute at registration but not all marketplaces populate it in the initial registration payload. We can accept it as a vendor attribute written post-enrollment via our portal API; update will be versioned in audit logs.
- ACK window: by default Redwood acknowledges inbound POs within 24 hours for standard integrations. For guaranteed 48-hour SLA at Acme we can set a contract SLA in the order form to 48 hours to match your ops. If you require <24, that's an escalation and may need dedicated capacity.

Next steps: 
1) Jane — please send a sample PO XML or a screenshot of your ERP header to validate mapping (you indicated you'd try to attach).
2) Karthik — circulate the counter MSA when ready. Marissa, happy to coordinate a short 30-min legal / procurement sync with Acme if they request a call.

Thanks,
Mateo Alvarez\Staff Product Manager, Integrations\Redwood Inference

[Attachment: PO_Header_Mapping_Template.xlsx (XLSX)]"]
